concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-marketplaces-reconciliation-use-cases-first-year-focus-platform-user-level-reporting]] — 2026-09-15 Marketplace SMB-user transaction, payout and dispute reporting options, separating UI components from Accounting/Payout report grains and financial from non-financial dispute events; example arithmetic and Balance (BC)/(PC) labels conflict.
warnings: Accounting Report financial chargeback rows do not include non-financial dispute lifecycle events; the guide's Balance (BC) label conflicts with the linked report's Balance (PC) column.
The 100 payment/2 fee/820 Net Payout example row is not a per-transaction arithmetic formula, and dashboard/report rows do not prove bank receipt or final dispute resolution.
The Marketplace guide's point-of-sale example does not itself establish in-person availability for this Marketplace route.
